# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Applied both pending amendments. Amendment 1: Replaced the tautological `per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total` test in cycling.rs. The old test computed `tan_c = tan_total / volume_l` where `tan_total = tan_conc * volume_l`, so `tan_c == tan_conc` by construction — comparing `monod(tan_c, k)` with `monod(tan_conc, k)` was always an identity. The new test creates two TankState instances with the same total nutrient mass (TAN=30.0 mg) but different volumes (10 L vs 100 L), calls the production `step_nitrogen_cycle()` on both, and asserts the smaller tank (10× higher concentration) consumes more TAN due to stronger Monod limitation (small_tan_consumed > large_tan_consumed * 1.5). DOC is kept minimal (1.0 mg) so nitrification dominates over decomposer TAN production from mineralization. Amendment 2: Strengthened `loader_range_diagnostics_use_explicit_warning_lines` in tank_data/src/lib.rs from a single `contains("warning: preset...")` check to four content assertions verifying: (1) preset/category identifier, (2) parameter name "aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l", (3) out-of-range value "200", and (4) valid range bounds "0.1" and "5". Each assertion includes a debug message showing the actual diagnostic string on failure.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Read cycling.rs:1065-1175 to confirm the tautological test structure: old test computed tan_c = (tan_conc * volume_l) / volume_l = tan_conc, then compared monod(tan_c, k) with monod(tan_conc, k) — always identical, never called step_nitrogen_cycle()
2. [Completed] Rewrote per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total in cycling.rs with a build() closure creating TankState at specified geometry, fixed total mass (TAN=30.0, DOC=1.0), identical biomass, disabled growth/decay. Created 10L (20×10×50cm) and 100L (100×10×100cm) tanks, called step_nitrogen_cycle() on both, asserted small_tan_consumed > large_tan_consumed * 1.5
3. [Completed] First attempt with high DOC (50.0) failed — decomposer mineralization produced TAN faster than nitrifiers consumed it. Fixed by reducing DOC to 1.0 mg and increasing TAN to 30.0 mg so nitrification dominates
4. [Completed] Ran cargo test -p tank_core --test cycling per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total: PASS — small tank consumed significantly more TAN than large tank
5. [Completed] Read tank_data/src/lib.rs:330-340 to confirm weakened diagnostic assertion: only checked diagnostics[0].contains("warning: preset `test` in category `process`") without verifying parameter name, value, or range bounds
6. [Completed] Added three additional assertions to loader_range_diagnostics_use_explicit_warning_lines: contains("aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l") for parameter name, contains("200") for out-of-range value, contains("0.1") && contains("5") for valid range bounds — each with debug message showing actual diagnostic string
7. [Completed] Ran cargo test -p tank_data loader_range_diagnostics_use_explicit_warning_lines: PASS — all four content assertions verified
8. [Completed] Ran full task-relevant test sweep: cycling (18/18), co2_exchange (12/12), chemistry (21/21), dissolved_oxygen (5/5), concentration_helpers (11/11), shrimp_feeding_pathway (8/8), shrimp_population (18/19 — 1 pre-existing failure), tank_data (32/32) — all task-related tests pass
9. [Completed] Ran cargo fmt --check -p tank_core and cargo fmt --check -p tank_data: both clean
10. [Completed] Ran cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings, cargo clippy -p tank_data -- -D warnings, cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings: all clean, 0 warnings

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test -p tank_core --test cycling per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total: PASS — new test exercises production step_nitrogen_cycle() with 10L vs 100L tanks holding same total mass, asserts higher-concentration tank consumes more TAN
- cargo test -p tank_data loader_range_diagnostics_use_explicit_warning_lines: PASS — asserts diagnostic contains preset identifier, parameter name 'aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l', value '200', and range bounds '0.1' and '5'
- cargo test -p tank_core --test cycling: 18 passed, 0 failed — full cycling suite including amended test
- cargo test -p tank_core --test co2_exchange: 12 passed, 0 failed — CO2 gas exchange tests intact
- cargo test -p tank_core --test chemistry: 21 passed, 0 failed — carbonate solver and pH integration intact
- cargo test -p tank_core --test dissolved_oxygen: 5 passed, 0 failed — shared K_LA infrastructure intact
- cargo test -p tank_core --test concentration_helpers: 11 passed, 0 failed — volume helpers and GH precision intact
- cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_feeding_pathway: 8 passed, 0 failed — feeding and egg development paths intact
- cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population: 18 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing shrimp_removal_validation) — population lifecycle paths intact
- cargo test -p tank_data: 32 passed, 0 failed — full tank_data suite including amended diagnostic test
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings: clean, 0 warnings
- cargo clippy -p tank_data -- -D warnings: clean, 0 warnings
- cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings: clean, 0 warnings
- cargo fmt --check -p tank_core: clean
- cargo fmt --check -p tank_data: clean

## Outstanding Risks

- Pre-existing test failure shrimp_population::shrimp_removal_validation (InvariantViolation on animal.egg_cohort_count_total) — confirmed fails without task changes, unrelated to gas exchange or nitrogen cycle
- Pre-existing test failures depth_light_attenuation::shallow_vs_deep_200h_plant_growth and shallow_vs_deep_algae_competition — file was added by another task (tanksim-6e5.2.3.5) after our checkpoint 31e76a3, entirely unrelated to this task
